sn11.18:1.4: Indra’s thousandfold team of horses evoke the swift, thundering storm (Rig Veda 6.47.18, 7.91.6).
sn11.18:1.8: Gods were often revered in particular quarters (eg. Atharva Veda 19.17).
sn11.18:5.1: This is pretty radical. For the gods to worship ascetics is common, but for them to worship mere ethical householders?
